verification.actual_validation: 2026-11-03: Android 36 emulator completed a real self-account CAS login and a single read-only timetable index/week request, then displayed the week grid/today section and reopened from offline cache. Later the same day M4 completed a real self-account libseat CAS login, app-token/seat-token exchange, /rest/v2/user identity check, and read-only filters/current-reservation calls; no seat layout, booking, cancellation or check-in was executed. A post-review correction added controlled manual-WebView identity binding and session-revision cleanup; it was verified with [REDACTED] Android/JVM tests only and the real CAS was not rerun. No course text, account, credentials, tokens or session values are recorded here. Separately, the six-entry library/space study used six user-authorized local HAR captures: libseat read-only APIs; nspace venue/roomType/date/roomList; seat/seatengine entrance config/index/identity and empty current/near reservations; reservepc two tenants with 8 and 23 reserve items respectively and empty user lists. All captures start from already-authorized pages; no CAS/passport login exchange, token acquisition or write request was captured or executed. M5 follow-up: the nspace entry was verified to redirect to CAS and the independent nspace auth/read-only client was implemented with synthetic protocol/account-isolation tests. On 2026-11-04 user-provided local credentials were used once in a debug test; nspace and libseat reached CAS but the POST returned a 401 login/captcha page. The client now maps that page to INTERACTION_REQUIRED with the school interaction URL instead of ACCESS_DENIED, and no retry or bypass was attempted; identity/read calls did not run. Chaoxing seat/seatengine remain browser fallbacks and reservepc remains blocked by missing stable tenant context. No real booking/cancel/check-in was executed and no credential, cookie or token value is recorded. On 2026-11-12, UPC Pocket 2.0.5 development added a restricted manual WebView fallback for card-history authentication with synthetic policy/protocol/session tests; no real captcha page or school account was used to validate this branch. On 2026-11-14, e站通 final scoped tests totalled 499 cases: 497 passed, 2 explicit live-network tests skipped, no failure/error. The final three-module run executed 370 cases; unchanged auth tests contributed 129. Debug and AndroidTest packaging, boundaries and signed R8/resource shrink Release passed. An Android-only PatternSyntaxException from (?U) was reproduced with a synthetic instrumentation probe and fixed by explicit Unicode White_Space code-point scanning. Public catalog and local page 2 rendered on Android; a single guide request returned a visible network error. No credential, protected CAS or personal endpoint was used. Final installation/public-path evidence is recorded in docs/releases/2.0.5-development.md. The final signed APK was installed with matching certificate/version and unchanged firstInstallTime; its pulled bytes matched the build and delivery copy. One manual guide refresh and one manual search recheck succeeded after preserved network failures. Clearing search restored 194 public items, offline pagination reached page 2/10, and same-query offline refresh retained results with an explicit error. Ordinary background process death and one production timetable-widget cold refresh/whole-card navigation were exercised without an account.
